item.title: Home Secretary gives further details of 'earned settlement' proposals
item.body: The Home Secretary made a statement in the House of Commons yesterday on the 'earned settlement' proposals. A detailed response to the consultation was published around the same time, eight months on from the consultation.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏠 Home Secretary gives further details of 'earned settlement' proposals

The Home Secretary made a statement in the House of Commons yesterday on the 'earned settlement' proposals. A detailed response to the consultation was published around the same time, eight months on from the consultation.
